description: Canal-belt cornice house of the 18th c. (lijstgevel; Herengracht 92-108 west side): a 6-9 m front of brick (natural buff, brown, or painted dark grey-brown) over a souterrain and a stoop, a tall bel-etage and three diminishing upper storeys of three axes of white-framed 2-over-2 sashes with white sills, crowned by a deep white entablature (about 2.3 m) whose frieze holds one dark attic light per axis under a moulded cap

match.note: Herengracht 92 (175700) and 94 (175699), 2021-01-25 strip at 40 px/m: eaves 16.6-16.9 m (3DBAG), entablature foot 14.2 m; Herengracht 92 carries a carved crest over the cornice to 18.0 m (crown `crest`). BAG years are 1630-1740 (the cores), the fronts are 18th-c. refacings, so the years are wide and the strip decides. No crownMatch: canal-side trees reach over every cornice on the winter strips and the skyline reads branches as crowns (Herengracht 94: rise 4.9 m); the crest variant is pinned per pand (review-crowns)

crest.note: a carved crest over the middle of the cornice (Herengracht 92, 175700: 16.6-18.0 m)

pediment.note: a pointed pediment standing on the middle of the cornice (Herengracht 96, 167714)

stoop-door-left.note: souterrain to about 1.9 m, the house door on the bel-etage up a stoop on the left axis (Herengracht 92); a door on the right axis is mirrored (Herengracht 94). The souterrain takes the default weight 1 against the storeys' 2.1/1.6/1.39/1.37 (1.9 m of 16.6 m on Herengracht 92), so a shop ground without a souterrain keeps a valid list

rhythm.bays: 3 axes (4 over 7.6 m, 5 over 9.8 m: the double-wide Herengracht fronts)
rhythm.groundFloor: a stoop to the bel-etage door, souterrain lights under it
rhythm.roofline: a deep white entablature with one attic light per axis, sometimes a carved crest
schemaLimits: the cornice consoles between the attic lights are drawn as plain entablature
the door surround (pilasters, transom light) is drawn as a plain door with the window over it
the stoop's iron railing is not drawn

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2021-01-25 gridded at 2x (grid-crop.ts 3423-3953): door sills 2.0-2.3 m; bel-etage windows 2.0-5.4 m; s1 6.2-8.6; s2 9.3-11.1; s3 12.0-13.7; white entablature 14.2 m to the cap at 16.3-16.6 m with three attic lights 1.1 x 0.45 m at 14.85-15.3 m; windows 1.3 m wide, 2-over-2 sashes in white frames

notes: Roof: the quay camera (about 2 m up, 5-30 m off) sees no roof face over a 2.3 m entablature, so the front gives no roof form; the 3DBAG-capped attic is kept. A front hip (`hip: front`, 50 deg) drew a pyramid over the cornice on Herengracht 96 that the strip never shows (tried 2026-11-10, reverted).
